test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: We can never solvve our problems.
We can never solve our problems.
We can never solve our problams.
We can nver solve our problems.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **correct sentence** is: *We can never solve our problems.*
 
• This **sentence is spelled correctly**, with each word following standard English spelling rules.
 
• Explanation for the incorrect options:
 
 
• **"solvve" **is misspelled. The correct spelling is **"solve."**
 
• **"problams"** is misspelled. The correct spelling is **"problems."**
 
• **"nver"** is misspelled. The correct spelling is** "never."**
